Usage: svg [--help] [--output] [--layers] [--mirror] [--theme] [--black-and-white] [--page-size-mode] [--exclude-drawing-sheet] input

Positional arguments:
  input                    Input file

Optional arguments:
  -h, --help               shows help message and exits
  -o, --output             Output file name
  -l, --layers             Comma separated list of untranslated layer names to include such as F.Cu,B.Cu
  -m, --mirror             Mirror the board (useful for trying to show bottom layers)
  -t, --theme              Color theme to use (will default to pcbnew settings)
  --black-and-white        Black and white only
  --page-size-mode         Set page sizing mode (0 = page with frame and title block, 1 = current page size, 2 = board area only)
  --exclude-drawing-sheet  No drawing sheet
